description: World commodity prices from the World Bank's Pink Sheet, monthly since 1960: oil, gas, LNG and coal, metals and precious metals, grains, oilseeds, coffee, cocoa, sugar, cotton, rubber, timber and fertilizers, each with its change on a month, a year and five years, beside the World Bank's sector indexes; or one commodity month by month with its record; all for every commodity. A plain summary first. No key.

all.description: Every commodity in the Pink Sheet (about seventy), not only the headline ones.

commodity.description: One commodity by name (copper, Brent, iron ore, cocoa, urea, LNG...): its price month by month with its record.

months.description: commodity: months shown, latest last; default 25.

name: commodity_prices

outputSchema.description: rows are commodities in the order of columns (latest monthly price and its changes), indices the sector indexes; with commodity, rows are months (oldest first).

title: Commodity prices (World Bank Pink Sheet)
